subject: Short-term compute/credit bridge request — Greenfield Lab pilot
messages:
From: Dr. Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@greenfieldlab.org>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@greenfieldlab.org
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term compute extension for Greenfield Lab pilot

Hi Kimberly,

I'm Lena Ortiz, PI at Greenfield Lab (nonprofit research org). We're in the middle of a three-month pilot of Redwood hosted inference for our deidentification pipeline. The team has made good progress, but our IRB review ran longer than expected and a chunk of our scheduled runs slipped — we need a short credit/top-up to finish the evaluation and produce the deliverables for our funder.

High-level ask: a bridge of compute credits equivalent to ~75k tokens (roughly $3-5k depending on the plan) to cover continued testing from mid-June through the end of August. If possible, an extension of the trial window until 2028-09-15 would be ideal.

Why: we have cleaned and validated ~40k records and were planning a final run and qualitative evals in June. IRB paperwork delayed access to a second data subset until last week; we need to run that subset and then perform inter-annotator checks. Without an extension we'll have to pause and lose momentum with our student contributors.

Attachments: I can provide the IRB acknowledgement and the grant letter on request (we have both pending final signatures). Happy to share a short project plan and estimated monthly token usage (we're seeing ~1.2M tokens/month in runs).

Thank you for considering — happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call if it's easier.

Best,
Dr. Lena Ortiz
Principal Investigator
Greenfield Lab
lena.ortiz@greenfieldlab.org
+1 415-555-0182
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@greenfieldlab.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term compute extension for Greenfield Lab pilot

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and context.

We can often accommodate nonprofit/edu pilots with a short-term bridge while IRB or procurement clears. To move quickly, could you send: 1) a one-paragraph summary of the remaining work and deliverables, 2) the expected token/month and the target end date, and 3) any org documentation (IRS non-profit cert or grant award letter) you can share. If you have a Drive link that’s easiest.

Ben — looping you in to assess the credit amount and process. Marissa — FYI from the credits/programs side; she can approve nonprofit supplements.

If they need it fast I can provision a temporary promo while we collect the paperwork, but want to confirm scope/limits before I do that. Lena, is the data in these runs production-sensitive? (i.e., PHI/PII beyond what IRB covers).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sales Lead, Research Programs
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Dr. Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@greenfieldlab.org>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@greenfieldlab.org
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term compute extension for Greenfield Lab pilot

Kimberly — thank you for the quick reply. Answers below and attaching the IRB acknowledgement and grant award letter.

1) Summary of remaining work (one paragraph): run de-identification model on held-out subset (approx 12k records), validate outputs with two annotators (~200 random samples) and compute recall/precision metrics, then run a final batch to generate deliverable CSVs for the funder.
2) Expected usage and timeline: we estimate ~1.2M tokens/month; target end date for the pilot is 2028-09-15 if an extension is possible.
3) Org docs: attaching IRB acknowledgement (greenfield_irb_notice.pdf) and grant award (greenfield_grant_letter.pdf). Drive folder with project plan/annotator instructions: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1example-share-link

Data sensitivity: the dataset is deidentified model outputs and limited PHI elements covered by our IRB (we are not using raw identifiers in model inputs).

Appreciate your help — if you need anything else to expedite, please let me know.

Best,
Lena

Attachments: greenfield_irb_notice.pdf (PDF), greenfield_grant_letter.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Dr. Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@greenfieldlab.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term compute extension for Greenfield Lab pilot

Thanks for the details, Lena — that helps. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can size the promo correctly:

- Confirm the account/org legal name you want the credit applied to (for our billing records).
- Does Greenfield already have a Redwood account ID for this pilot? If so, please share the account ID.
- Are you running any calls that include raw identifiers or PII beyond what IRB allows (you said deidentified outputs — just want explicit confirmation).

Operationally we can offer a short-term pilot top-up. My initial thought is a one-time credit equivalent to ~75k tokens (we'll convert to USD and apply as a promo credit in your console). We'll need a short addendum that restricts use to the pilot and non-training/no-export clauses (standard). If you have a procurement team, a PO would be fine, otherwise the addendum + org docs suffice.

If you can reply with the account info and confirm the PII question, I can draft the promo and loop in ops for provisioning.

Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Dr. Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@greenfieldlab.org>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term compute extension for Greenfield Lab pilot

Hi all — reviewed Lena's docs. Approved: we can provide a one-time promo credit equal to 75,000 tokens for Greenfield Lab with the following conditions:

- Credit is restricted to the account associated with Greenfield Lab and expires 90 days after provisioning.
- Credit is for evaluation use only (model inference for de-identification). Training/fine-tuning on Redwood infrastructure is not permitted under this promo.
- Greenfield must sign the Redwood Credit Addendum (short form) confirming scope and data handling; I’ve attached the addendum stub and will route a DocuSign if Lena confirms the account/legal info.
- We request a short shared tracking sheet (I can create one) so we can measure impact; please update weekly.

Next steps: Lena — please confirm account legal name and whether you have an existing Redwood account ID. I will prepare the DocuSign and routing for provisioning once signed.

Marissa Cole
Programs — Research & Nonprofit Credits
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_credit_addendum_2028-Greenfield.pdf (PDF, stub)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@greenfieldlab.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term compute extension for Greenfield Lab pilot

Lena — great, we’re all set to proceed.

Summary / what I’ll do now:
- Marissa has approved a one-time 75,000-token promo credit. I will provision it to the account you confirm below; credit will expire 90 days after provisioning.
- Please confirm the legal account name and account ID (if you have one). If you don't have an account ID, confirm the legal name and billing contact and we will provision to a new account and send you console access.
- Marissa will send the DocuSign addendum (redwood_credit_addendum_2028-Greenfield.pdf) — please sign so we can release the credit.
- After provisioning you'll see the promo in Console > Billing > Credits and you'll get an email confirmation.

Thanks for moving quickly on the docs. If you want me to provision the promo before the signed addendum (so you can keep the runs going), we can do a conditional provisioning but we prefer to have the signed addendum within 5 business days of credit delivery. Let me know which you prefer.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sales Lead, Research Programs
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Related links: HS-Record-48291; Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1example-share-link
